evals.name: three-loops-from-fun-targeting
evals.prompt: Concept: Fog Keeper — tend a lighthouse on a foggy island where the fog remembers what you did yesterday. Target fun from fun-targeting: Discovery, Submission, Narrative. Mechanics: trim the wick, wind the lens, log passing ships, leave lamps lit or dark on the shore path, the fog replays last night's choices as shapes. Draw the core loops.
evals.expected_output: Exactly 3 Mermaid flowchart blocks (moment-to-moment, session, long-term), each with action, system, feedback and decision nodes, every feedback edge labeled with one kind of fun, plus the nesting, the feedback-to-fun map and gaps.
expectations: Every feedback edge carries a kind-of-fun label
Each loop closes back to a player action

evals.name: concept-only
evals.prompt: Draw the gameplay loops for this: Clackety-Clack — a rhythm game where you slam one-way rail gates open on the clack of the wheels to route the day's only desert train; miss a beat and it takes the wrong branch. Sessions are 10 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Infers 2-3 target kinds (likely Challenge and Sensation) and states them under Assumptions, then draws exactly 3 labeled Mermaid loops without asking a question.
expectations: States inferred target fun under Assumptions
Does not ask the user a question

checks.pattern: (would you like|do you want|could you (tell|clarify)|let me know which)

evals.name: primary-on-moment-edge
evals.prompt:
Concept: Soup Relay — two to four friends run one night-market soup stall; the ladle, the bowls and the till are at opposite ends of a tiny cart. Sessions are 8 minutes.
fun-targeting result: blend team-under-pressure; primary: Fellowship; target fun: Fellowship, Challenge, Sensation. Mechanics: pass bowls hand to hand, one ladle shared by all, an order clock, a gong and a steam burst on every served bowl, a nightly stall upgrade. Draw the core loops.
evals.expected_output: Exactly 3 labeled Mermaid loops. The moment-to-moment loop has at least one feedback edge labeled Fellowship (the primary). Challenge and Sensation each label an edge in the moment-to-moment or session loop. The output ends with the fold-in self-check line saying yes twice.
expectations: The primary kind labels a moment-to-moment edge
Every target kind labels a moment-to-moment or session edge
Ends with the one-line fold-in self-check

checks.description: primary Fellowship on a moment-to-moment edge
Challenge on a moment-to-moment or session edge
Sensation on a moment-to-moment or session edge

patterns: ^\*\*Fold-in check:\*\* primary Fellowship on a moment-to-moment edge: yes\..*session edge: yes
